slides.title: A gated rollout can add $60k of annual profit.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.
slides.recommendation: Approve a six-week pilot, then release rollout funding if the guardrails pass.
reasons: The $960k cost base gives us three measurable levers.
Net savings of $60k support a 15-month simple payback.
Adoption, quality and cost gates limit execution risk.
slides.impact: $105k three-year net benefit after $75k upfront investment; before tax and discounting.

slides.title: The decision is how to reduce cost without hurting quality.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.
slides.body: A fictional service business earns $1.20m revenue and spends $960k each year. The team must decide whether to redesign intake, fulfilment and support. We assume unchanged revenue and steady demand. All figures are illustrative.

slides.title: Fulfilment accounts for 69% of the cost base.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.
bullets: Cost concentration guides investigation, not an automatic cut.

slides.title: The savings bridge produces $60k of recurring benefit.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.

slides.title: The downside case still needs a pilot decision gate.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.
bullets: Simple payback ranges from 30 to 10 months.
No probabilities are assigned to these scenarios.

slides.title: Six weeks of evidence should precede the funding decision.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.

phases.label: Weeks 1-2 | Baseline
phases.text: Owner: operations lead. Record cost per case, error rate and adoption.

phases.label: Weeks 3-5 | Pilot
phases.text: Owner: workflow manager. Trial one team; review metrics weekly.

phases.label: Week 6 | Gate
phases.text: Owner: sponsor. Review >=80% adoption, stable errors and verified savings.

slides.title: Three explicit stop rules protect service quality.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.

risks.mitigation: Extend training and hold rollout funding.
Pause the trial and review failed cases.
Reprice the plan and recalculate payback.

slides.title: The cash-flow bridge is transparent and reproducible.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.
bullets: Excludes tax, discounting and pilot timing.

slides.title: The panel can challenge each decision assumption.
slides.source: Illustrative figures only; inputs/operations.json; USD thousands unless stated.
bullets: Why not cut fulfilment first? Cost concentration alone does not prove avoidable cost.
What if savings are half the base case? Simple payback extends to 30 months.
What if revenue changes? Rebuild the contribution and working-capital model.
What releases funding? Verified savings, >=80% adoption and stable quality.
